_comment: Readiness policy for §5.1 criteria. Values here are policy choices, not data-derived constants; each carries its rationale so a reviewer can challenge the number itself.

stock_turnover.rationale: Turnover feeds the §3.1 liquidity screen, the §7 execution-capacity cap and the §10.3 unexecutable-order ratio. A backtest may be limited to the covered subset, but a subset too thin to fill 25 holdings with industry diversification cannot support those metrics. 0.20 with an absolute floor of 200 covered securities is a policy floor, chosen to be reachable with current sources while forcing the uncovered remainder to be declared; it is not derived from the data.
stock_turnover.remainder_rule: Securities without turnover are excluded from selection and must appear in the backtest conclusion as an explicit scope limitation.
